# Grok Bot, in plain English

> A plain-language guide to Grok Bot, xAI's always-on AI helpers: what it is, how it works, the 56 ready-made jobs it can take on, what it costs, and what to trust it with. Written for non-technical readers. Not affiliated with xAI.

Grok Bot launched in beta on 11 August 2026. Helpers work on a cloud computer that stays on, sign into the tools you already use, and come back when they need a decision. Helpers on one account share that computer. It is distinct from Grok (the chat assistant at grok.com) and from @grok (the reply account on X).

## Pages
- [Overview](/): what it is in short, four key concepts, where to start
- [How it works](/how-it-works): hiring an assistant rather than using an app; Grok vs @grok on X vs Grok Bot; five things to know (cloud computer shared per account, show it once, runs on a schedule, learns your way, helpers work together, X connector); a morning start to finish
- [56 jobs you could hand over](/jobs): searchable, grouped by Everyday, Sales, Marketing, Support, Hiring, Money, Product, Technical, Personal; each tagged with a suggested cadence (one-off, recurring, monitoring) and oversight level (low, review, approval)
- [Avatar system](/avatar-system): interactive studio, 8 shapes, 12 colours, 16 expressions, 15 exported state previews, the six working moods, how the avatar is drawn
- [Getting started](/getting-started): eight things to say on day one with links to xAI's ready-made helpers; choosing a first job; your first week (observe, delegate, refine, loosen)
- [Trust & cost](/trust-and-cost): hand over / review / approve; what to trust it with; an oversight matrix; what it costs (SuperGrok from $30/mo, Cursor Pro from $20/mo, Cursor Teams from $40/seat, enterprise on request); keeping costs predictable
- [Sources & methodology](/sources): official, community and outside sources, and what is official versus inferred

## Key facts
- Maker: xAI (SpaceXAI), built with Cursor. Launched 11 Aug 2026, enterprise 3 Sep 2026. Still in beta.
- Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux, iPhone (iOS 18+), Android 9+. Not iPad.
- Not sold standalone; bundled with SuperGrok (not Lite), Cursor Pro and up, Cursor Teams, or by linking X Premium+. Helper usage is a weekly allowance, then on-demand. SuperGrok Lite is not included.
- Official pages: https://x.ai/bot, https://x.ai/bot/use-cases, https://x.ai/bot/marketplace, https://x.ai/bot/guides, https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/faq
